[[Financial services]]
Construction Equipment leasing | revenue = Rs 462.4 cr{{cite web |title=Indiabulls NSE Report |url=https://www.indiabulls.com/public/pdfs/1770032886_IB_BM_Outcome_02022026_signed.pdf |website=Indiabulls}} | parent = | website = {{url|https://www.indiabulls.com}} }} [[File:Indiabulls logo.svg|thumb| Old logo of Indiabulls]] '''Indiabulls Limited''' is an Indian publicly listed company headquartered in [[Gurgaon]], with operations in [[real estate development]], [[financial services]], and [[construction equipment|construction equipment leasing]]. The company was formed in its current structure on 14 October 2025, following a National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT)-approved scheme of arrangement that merged 17 entities — including Dhani Services Limited and Indiabulls Enterprises Limited — into the formerly listed Yaari Digital Integrated Services Limited, which was subsequently renamed Indiabulls Limited.{{cite web |title=Dhani to Merge with Yaari Digital on Oct 28 |url=https://hdfcsky.com/news/dhani-services-to-merge-with-yaari-digital-tomorrow |website=HDFC Sky |language=en-IN}}{{cite web |title=Indiabulls Limited Confirms No Deviation in Fund Utilization Post-Merger - TipRanks.com |url=https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/indiabulls-limited-confirms-no-deviation-in-fund-utilization-post-merger |website=TipRanks Financial |publisher=[[TipRanks]] |language=en}}{{cite web | title=Indiabulls set to launch operations in Gulf countries | website=The Economic Times | date=2013-06-13 | url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/indiabulls-set-to-launch-operations-in-gulf-countries/articleshow/20571577.cms?from=mdr | access-date=2024-04-19}} ==History== Indiabulls was started in 2000 with the establishment of Indiabulls Financial Services, a stockbroking firm co-founded by three [[IIT Delhi]] graduates–[[Sameer Gehlaut]], [[RattanIndia|Rajiv Rattan]] and [[Saurabh Mittal]].{{Cite news|title=Ransomware allegedly hits Indiabulls Group: Cyble|work=[[The Economic Times]]|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/ransomware-allegedly-hits-indiabulls-group-cyble/articleshow/76525764.cms|access-date=22 August 2020|archive-date=17 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201117225608/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/ransomware-allegedly-hits-indiabulls-group-cyble/articleshow/76525764.cms|url-status=live}}{{cite news |title=The Rs 29,000-crore surprise |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/in-this-issue/story/the-rs-29000crore-surprise-13029-2007-10-04 |access-date=2 August 2023 |work=Business Today |date=4 October 2007 |language=en}} Indiabulls Financial Services subsequently set up subsidiaries in stockbroking, consumer finance, housing finance and real estate, among others.{{cite news |title=Indiabulls set for revamp |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/indiabulls-set-for-revamp/articleshow/1560581.cms |access-date=2 August 2023 |work=The Times of India | date=5 February 2007}} In 2004, Indiabulls Financial Services became a [[publicly-listed company]] after its [[initial public offering]].{{cite news |title=Indiabulls IPO at Rs 19 |url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/business/indiabulls-ipo-at-rs-19/cid/959368 |access-date=2 August 2023 |work=The Telegraph |language=en}} Indiabulls Real Estate was [[demerger|demerged]] from the company in 2006,{{cite news |title=Indiabulls to demerge its real estate business |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/indiabulls-to-demerge-its-real-estate-business/articleshow/1511773.cms |access-date=2 August 2023 |work=The Economic Times |date=2 May 2006}} and Indiabulls Securities in 2008.{{cite news |title=Indiabulls Financial slips on hiving off securities biz |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/indiabulls-financial-slips-on-hiving-off-securities-biz/articleshow/2666712.cms |access-date=2 August 2023 |work=The Economic Times |date=1 January 2008}} In 2013, Indiabulls Financial Services reverse merged with its wholly owned subsidiary, Indiabulls Housing Finance, to form the flagship company of the group.{{cite news |title=Indiabulls Financial Services completes reverse merger |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/indiabulls-financial-services-completes-reverse-merger-113030900010_1.html |access-date=2 August 2023 |work=Business Standard}} In 2014, the group was split between the three [[Corporate promoter|promoters]] with Sameer Gehlaut retaining management control over Indiabulls Housing Finance, Indiabulls Real Estate, Indiabulls Securities and Indiabulls Wholesale Services, while Rajiv Rattan and Saurabh Mittal obtained control of Indiabulls Power (renamed RattanIndia Power) and Indiabulls Infrastructure (renamed RattanIndia Infrastructure).{{cite news |title=Indiabulls' three promoters split Rs 8.8k cr group |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/indiabulls-three-promoters-split-rs-8-8k-cr-group/articleshow/38096408.cms |access-date=2 August 2023 |work=The Times of India |date=10 July 2014}} By 2017, Indiabulls Housing Finance had become the second-largest housing finance company in India{{cite news |title=Indiabulls HF appoints Mundra as a director |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/indiabulls-hf-appoints-mundra-as-a-director/article24732078.ece |access-date=8 September 2023 |work=The Hindu |date=19 August 2018 |language=en-IN}} and was included in the [[NIFTY 50]] benchmark index.{{cite news |title=IOC, IBHFL to replace Idea, BHEL in NSE Nifty50 from March 31 |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/ioc-ibhfl-to-replace-idea-bhel-in-nse-nifty50-from-march-31-117021600934_1.html |access-date=8 September 2023 |work=Business Standard}} However, between late 2018 and 2019, its shares and bonds experienced a sharp decline in value due to a credit market crisis triggered by the collapse of [[IL&FS]], the company's shrinking [[balance sheet]], allegations of fraud by group promoters, and a proposed merger with the beleaguered [[Lakshmi Vilas Bank]], which fell through.{{cite news |title=Indiabulls Housing: Sameer Gehlaut Sells Half His Stake, Plans on Exiting the Board by Fiscal End |url=https://thewire.in/business/indiabulls-housing-sameer-gehlaut-sells-half-his-stake-plans-on-exiting-the-board-by-fiscal-end |access-date=8 September 2023 |work=The Wire}} In 2020, the group announced that it would exit Indiabulls Real Estate in a merger deal with [[Embassy Group]] entities.{{cite news |last1=Priolker |first1=Ashwini |title=Indiabulls Real Estate Approves Share-Swap Ratio For Merger With Embassy Group |url=https://www.bqprime.com/business/indiabulls-real-estate-approves-share-swap-ratio-for-merger-with-embassy-group |access-date=9 September 2023 |work=BQ Prime |date=18 August 2020 |language=en}} Sameer Gehlaut stepped down as the chairman of Indiabulls Housing Finance in 2020{{cite news |title=Gehlaut steps down as chief of Indiabulls Housing Finance |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/gehlaut-steps-down-as-chief-of-indiabulls-housing-fin/articleshow/77513160.cms |access-date=10 September 2023 |work=The Times of India |date=13 August 2020}} and ceased to be its promoter in 2023.{{cite news |title=Exchanges approve reclassification of Indiabulls Housing promoter Sameer Gehlaut to public |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/indiabulls-housing-finance-sameer-gehlaut-promoter-reclassification-to-public-shares-16011491.htm |access-date=10 September 2023 |work=CNBC TV18 |date=23 February 2023 |language=en}} In July 2024, Indiabulls Housing Finance was renamed as Sammaan Capital, while Indiabulls Real Estate was renamed as Equinox India Developments.{{cite news |last1=Jayaraj |first1=Prajwal |title=Indiabulls Real Estate To Be Renamed As Equinox India Developments |url=https://www.ndtvprofit.com/business/indiabulls-real-estate-to-be-renamed-as-equinox-india-developments |access-date=22 October 2024 |work=NDTV Profit |date=3 July 2024 |language=en}} In 2025, [[Dhani (company)|Dhani Services Limited]] and Indiabulls Enterprises Limited were merged into Yaari Digital Integrated Services Limited, which was subsequently renamed Indiabulls Limited.{{cite web |title=Dhani to Merge with Yaari Digital on Oct 28 |url=https://hdfcsky.com/news/dhani-services-to-merge-with-yaari-digital-tomorrow |website=HDFC Sky |language=en-IN}}{{cite news |title=Yaari Digital Integrated Services Completes Major Merger Scheme, Rebrands as Indiabulls Limited |url=https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/corporate-actions/yaari-digital-integrated-services-completes-major-merger-scheme-rebrands-as-indiabulls-limited/21993301 |work=scanx.trade |language=en}} == Group companies == Indiabulls Limited, which was created in 2025 as a result of the merger of: *[[Dhani (company)|Dhani Services]] (formerly Indiabulls Ventures or Indiabulls Securities){{Cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/indiabulls-ventures-subsidiary-launches-mobile-application-dhani-app-117102500147_1.html|title=Indiabulls Ventures' subsidiary launches mobile application 'Dhani App'|website=Business Standard News|access-date=11 February 2019|archive-date=12 February 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190212011511/https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/indiabulls-ventures-subsidiary-launches-mobile-application-dhani-app-117102500147_1.html|url-status=live}} *Indiabulls Enterprises (including Indiabulls Store One{{cite news |title=SORIL Infra Resources History |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/soril-infra-resources-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-17663.cms |access-date=19 November 2021 |work=The Economic Times |archive-date=19 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211119211811/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/soril-infra-resources-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-17663.cms |url-status=live }} and Indiabulls LED{{cite news |last1=Sapam |first1=Bidya |title=Indiabulls Group enters LED lighting business |url=https://www.livemint.com/Industry/4d7BvxtiLC85MYXOt1vuML/Indiabulls-Group-enters-LED-lighting-business.html |access-date=19 November 2021 |work=mint |date=25 May 2017 |language=en |archive-date=19 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211119211808/https://www.livemint.com/Industry/4d7BvxtiLC85MYXOt1vuML/Indiabulls-Group-enters-LED-lighting-business.html |url-status=live }}) *Yaari Digital Integrated Services (formerly Indiabulls Integrated Services or Indiabulls Wholesale Services){{cite news |title=Sebi exempts Sameer Gehlaut IIS Trust from open offer obligation |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/market/sebi-exempts-sameer-gehlaut-iis-trust-from-open-offer-obligation/2216291/ |access-date=22 November 2021 |work=The Financial Express |date=19 March 2021 |archive-date=22 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211122085400/https://www.financialexpress.com/market/sebi-exempts-sameer-gehlaut-iis-trust-from-open-offer-obligation/2216291/ |url-status=live }} *Indiabulls Asset Reconstruction Company Limited *TranServ Limited ===Real estate development=== The company is engaged in developing residential and commercial projects across [[Mumbai]],{{Cite web |title=Indiabulls Park by Indiabulls - Project Details |url=https://housing.com/in/buy/projects/page/38313-indiabulls-park-by-indiabulls-in-derawali |access-date=26 April 2026}} the National Capital Region (NCR), and Ludhiana. In 2026, the company entered into a [[joint venture]] with a private land-owning entity for the development of a premium commercial project on approximately 2.38 acres of land located in Sector 103, [[Gurgaon]], along the Dwarka Expressway.{{Cite web |title=Indiabulls enters into JV for development of commercial project in Gurgaon |url=https://www.capitalmarket.com/markets/news/corporate-news/indiabulls-enters-into-jv-for-development-of-commercial-project-in-gurgaon/1682470 |access-date=26 April 2026}} Their real estate segment maintains a development pipeline of 140.65 lakh square feet across owned and joint venture projects.{{Cite web |title=Indiabulls Limited announces Q3 FY26 results following completion of corporate restructuring |url=https://alphastreet.com/india/indiabulls-limited-announces-q3-fy26-results-following-completion-of-corporate-restructuring/ |access-date=26 April 2026}} ==Financial Services== The financial services vertical is operated through the company’s subsidiaries and includes: ===Stock Broking=== Indiabulls Securities Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, provides equity, commodity, and currency broking services along with depository participant services.{{cite web |last1=Acharya |first1=Bhuma Shrivastava, Nupur |title=Indiabulls Ventures is world's top stock with nearly 900% gain |url=https://www.livemint.com/Money/mCshAE9NOBccJIOZgBcpCN/Indiabulls-Ventures-is-worlds-top-stock-with-almost-900-ga.html |website=mint |language=en |date=18 August 2017}} ===Asset Reconstruction (ARC)=== The ARC business acquires stressed asset portfolios from banks and NBFCs. Total assets under collection stand at approximately ₹3,800 crore.{{cite web |last1=Mascarenhas |first1=Rajesh |title=Indiabulls Asset Reconstructions gets RBI licence, to launch Ops |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/indiabulls-asset-reconstructions-gets-rbi-licence-to-launch-ops/articleshow/58784172.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=22 May 2017}} ===Digital Payments (UPI/Wallet)=== The company operates a digital wallet (Dhani Pay) and is transitioning to TPAP-enabled UPI services, with regulatory certification underway.{{cite web |title=Indiabulls-owned Dhani app disburses loans on PANs not belonging to borrowers |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/indiabulls-owned-dhani-app-disburses-loans-on-pans-not-belonging-to-borrowers/articleshow/89592080.cms |website=The Times of India |date=15 February 2022}} ===SMB Platform (Spring Cash)=== Indiabulls Limited holds a 16.4% stake in Spring Cash LLC, USA, a small and medium business lending platform.{{cite web |last1=Smith |first1=George |title=GB Bank funded US lender backed by its owner ‘on arm’s length basis’ |url=https://www.globalcapital.com/securitization/article/2g7o2g7bmpr604dtxm9s0/people-and-markets/market-news/gb-bank-funded-us-lender-backed-by-its-owner-on-arms-length-basis |website=GlobalCapital Securitization |language=en |date=8 April 2026}} ===NBFC=== Dhani Loans and Services Limited, a subsidiary, operates as a non-banking financial company offering personal loans, small business loans and credit line products to retail consumers and small businesses through digital platforms.{{cite web |title=What Is Dhani Services? A Complete Overview Of The Fintech Company Transforming Digital Finance In India - Business Connect Magazine |url=https://businessconnectindia.in/what-is-dhani-services/ |website=Businessconnectindia.in/ |date=30 October 2025}} ==References== {{Duplicated citations|reason=DuplicateReferences script detected: * https://hdfcsky.com/news/dhani-services-to-merge-with-yaari-digital-tomorrow (refs: 3, 21) |date=July 2026}} {{reflist|colwidth=30em}} ==External links== *{{Official website|https://www.indiabulls.com/}} [[Category:Companies based in Gurgaon]] [[Category:Financial services companies of India]] [[Category:Conglomerate companies of India]]
extract: Indiabulls Limited is an Indian publicly listed company headquartered in Gurgaon, with operations in real estate development, financial services, and construction equipment leasing. The company was formed in its current structure on 14 October 2025, following a National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT)-approved scheme of arrangement that merged 17 entities — including Dhani Services Limited and Indiabulls Enterprises Limited — into the formerly listed Yaari Digital Integrated Services Limited, which was subsequently renamed Indiabulls Limited.
